name: Remove/Hide Taxes
description:
The 'Remove Taxes' module allows users to hide or remove tax fields in various Odoo documents, including sales orders, purchase orders, customer invoices, and vendor bills. This module also removes tax information from related PDF reports, giving users the ability to streamline documents without showing tax details.

    Features:
    - Toggle the visibility of tax fields in sales orders, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor bills.
    - Remove taxes from the generated PDF reports for sales, purchases, invoices, and bills.
    - Quick and simple configuration to enable or disable tax visibility on specific document types.
    
    Benefits:
    - Simplifies document presentation by removing tax fields when not needed.
    - Provides flexibility in customizing documents and reports for different user needs.
    - Allows easy configuration via settings for each document type (sales orders, purchase orders, invoices, and bills).
    
    Navigation:
    - Users can enable or disable the tax visibility feature via the settings in Sales, Purchase, and Invoicing configurations.
    - Once enabled, taxes will be hidden from the form views as well as from the generated PDF reports.
